raw: “A gym towel in a locker comes to mind. It smelled of mildew, and it was sitting there in these damp folds. That dampness was what really disgusted me—then I noticed the dark blotches along the hem, and that made it worse. Once I’d noticed those, the smell seemed even more unpleasant. I work as a swimming pool caretaker, so a wet towel itself isn’t strange to me, but this was different: that musty smell and the blotches together. I really didn’t want to touch it.”
